premises.text: Current water purification methods have significant drawbacks

premises.text: Liquidity's technology can provide safe drinking water instantly without chemicals or electricity
premises.evidence_span: For the first time, you can get instantly safe drinking water with no chemicals, no electricity, and no pumping.

premises.text: The technology combines high effectiveness with convenience for everyday use
premises.evidence_span: we can combine effectiveness, remember, 99.9999%, with convenience, something that's hassle-free to create everyday-use products.

premises.text: The product can be used easily by anyone, including children
premises.evidence_span: it's so easy to use, my six-year-old loves drinking from this.

premises.text: The technology is based on advanced scientific research and development

premises.text: The company plans to target both developed and emerging markets for their products
